title: Book Three · Chapter 101: The Money They Keep
story:
On Tuesday, the boys finish checking the nine saleable books.

All their pages are there. One has pencil marks. Another has a loose cover corner. Ronan writes those details beside the titles.

The railway book is the only L book left. The other eight are B books. There are no R books in the remaining stock.

The two damaged B books stay separate.

Leo puts his pencil down and looks at the small piles.

“We have more money than we started with,” he says.

“Forty-three. We started with forty.”

“And nine books we can still sell.”

Ronan looks at the folded price card. “We also need a place for that.”

Both paid mornings are over. The table is back with Mr Qiu. The two cloth bags still belong to the joint sale.

Leo takes the cash envelope into his hands, then puts it back.

“We could split some.”

“Not yet,” Ronan says. “Someone else may bring a book back.”

Leo thinks for a moment. Then he nods.

“Keep the forty-three here. We count again before any split.”

He looks at the damaged story.

“We bought too fast.”

Ronan sits back. “You wanted to take the eight.”

“You wanted them too.”

Ronan looks at him. Leo does not look away.

“Yes,” Ronan says at last. “And I promised Mr Wei the whole stories.”

“I didn't tell you to stay on Saturday.”

“I know.”

Leo turns his pencil between two fingers.

“I wanted a quick sale. I still do. We can't spend all day on every thin book.”

“Then we need to say what we know about it.”

“Yes. Or check the special ones first.”

Ronan nods. It is not the same plan, but it is something they can use.

They make one clear list of the nine good books and the two damaged ones. Leo copies the list for himself.

Mum comes to collect her work basket. She sees the paper but does not take the envelope.

“Finished?” she asks.

“Not all of it,” Ronan says.

She nods and goes back to her customer near the window.

Leo checks the time. He needs lunch with his grandmother and an afternoon with his aunt.

At the gate, he stops.

“Saturday, the bus.”

“I remember.”

“I can't stay for another sale.”

“I know.”

Ronan stands aside and lets him go. Then he takes the folded large card from beneath the bags. He reads the hours once and puts it away with the account sheet.

The next thing to finish is not another price card.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

saleable＝可以继续出售的；joint＝共同的；split＝分配；account sheet＝账页。

## 理解问题

1. 现在的十一本书中，几本仍可售、几本有缺页？来源各是什么？
2. 两人为什么没有立即分钱？Leo是否被写成Ronan失约的唯一原因？

## 读句子

**The two damaged B books stay separate.**

拆开看：The two damaged B books / stay / separate.

那两本有缺页的B书／继续保持／单独存放。
